'''Endor Station''', also known as '''Bright Tree Base''' in honor of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], was a facility that was established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. 

The Endor Base was built from pre-fabricated structures and it included a starship hangar, medical facilities, and a command center.
